_about: READER-VOICES pronunciation lexicon for Blanks (Session B, 2026-09-22/23; checked by a speech recogniser, capture/lexicon_check.py). Applied before the voice, in order: (1) `cards` — fixes for one card id, `_whole` replacing the card's whole text; (2) `words` by exact token (a possessive 's kept); (3) `patterns`, regexes over what is left. Forms: {spell:true} the letters, {say:'…'} this text instead, {ipa:'…'} these phonemes (espeak notation). games/blanks/__tests__/pronounce.test.ts checks every card id exists.
